title: Payment Arrangement Completion, Cancellation on Closure and Lapse
content:
# Payment Arrangement Completion, Cancellation on Closure and Lapse

**Standard.** A Payment Arrangement plan is completed when its plan balance reaches zero through billed installments that have been paid, forgiveness, or an early payoff, and no installment is left unpaid past its cure period. When the service agreement carrying an active plan closes, the plan moves to the customer's new service agreement where the kind moves with the customer and the customer has opened one; otherwise the plan is cancelled and its remaining balance is returned to the closing agreement, where it becomes part of the final bill. A lapsed plan — one whose down payment was not received — has no balance to return.

## Outcomes by situation

| Situation | Kind moves with the customer | New agreement opened | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plan balance reaches zero, no installment unpaid past its cure period | — | — | Completed |
| Agreement carrying an active plan closes | Yes | Yes | Plan moves to the new agreement |
| Agreement carrying an active plan closes | Yes | No | Cancelled; remaining balance returned to the closing agreement's final bill |
| Agreement carrying an active plan closes | No | Any | Cancelled; remaining balance returned to the closing agreement's final bill |
| Down payment not received by its due date | — | — | Lapsed on the day after the due date; nothing to return |

## Hypothetical closure

A customer on an active Arrearage Management Program plan with $1240.00 still under the plan closes the account and opens service at a new address. The program does not move with the customer, so the plan is cancelled and the $1240.00 is returned to the closing agreement, where it becomes part of the final bill.
